
<html lang="en">
<head>

<meta name="theme-color" content="#371421"><title>17 Years of Togetherness | Mom & Dad</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=Jost:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#fcf5ec;--paper:#fffaf4;--ink:#371421;--muted:#795b60;--accent:#922e49;--gold:#9b712d;--line:#e6d4bd;--serif:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Jost',Arial,sans-serif; color-scheme:light}
:root[data-theme=dark]{--bg:#21131b;--paper:#30202a;--ink:#fbe9db;--muted:#d4b7b8;--accent:#f2a2b4;--gold:#e9c17e;--line:#64434c;color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);line-height:1.65}button,a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:5px}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);line-height:1.05}h2{font-size:clamp(2.7rem,7vw,4.7rem);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:20px}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.25em;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold)}.muted{color:var(--muted)}.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px clamp(16px,5vw,70px);gap:12px}.brand{font:600 1.6rem var(--serif);white-space:nowrap}.navlinks{display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:.85rem}.theme{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border-radius:50%;width:42px;height:42px;flex:none}.progress{position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;height:2px;background:var(--gold);width:0}.hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;min-height:calc(100svh - 67px);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:70px 22px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,#77384b,#371421 65%,#281019);color:#fff4e4}.hero:before,.hero:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:18px;border:1px solid #cba86b66;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}.hero:after{inset:25px;border-color:#cba86b33}.hero .eyebrow{color:#e9c68b}.hero-inner{max-width:850px;z-index:1}.rings{width:100px;height:65px;display:block;margin:0 auto 22px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #eac58255)}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,9vw,7rem);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:12px 0}.hero h1 em{display:block;font-size:.53em;font-weight:400;color:#e9c68b;letter-spacing:0;margin-top:12px}.hero p:not(.eyebrow){max-width:540px;margin:22px auto;color:#f0d9cf}.big17{font:600 clamp(5rem,15vw,10rem)/.75 var(--serif);color:#e9c68b;opacity:.9;margin:20px 0}.ornament{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;color:#d7b274;margin:24px auto}.ornament:before,.ornament:after{content:'';width:75px;height:1px;background:currentColor}.btn{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 25px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper);font-weight:600;transition:transform .2s,filter .2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.1)}.hero .btn{background:#e9c68b;color:#371421}.star{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;background:#f6d7a3;border-radius:50%;opacity:.45;animation:twinkle 4s infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}@keyframes twinkle{to{opacity:.08;transform:scale(.5)}}.section{max-width:1060px;margin:auto;padding:85px 24px;text-align:center}.intro{max-width:650px;margin:0 auto 32px;color:var(--muted)}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:35px}.stat{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px 8px;border-radius:8px}.stat b{display:block;font:600 clamp(2rem,5vw,3.5rem) var(--serif);color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.stat span{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.band{border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper)}.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;position:relative;margin-top:40px}.timeline article{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 12px}.timeline strong{font:600 2.8rem var(--serif);color:var(--gold)}.timeline h3{font-size:1.9rem;margin:8px 0}.timeline p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}.envelope{max-width:490px;margin:25px auto 0;position:relative;background:#e9d3b2;color:#542736;border:1px solid #c7a875;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;padding:72px 20px 35px;box-shadow:0 15px 40px #37142118}.envelope:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:#d8bc92;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 72%);transition:transform .7s;transform-origin:top}.envelope.open:before{transform:scaleY(-1)}.seal{position:relative;background:#922e49;color:#fff0dd;border:2px solid #ba6b75;border-radius:50%;width:66px;height:66px;font:2rem var(--serif);box-shadow:0 5px 10px #37142144}.envelope p{position:relative;margin:18px 0 0}.letter{max-width:720px;margin:26px auto 0;text-align:left;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:clamp(25px,6vw,60px);box-shadow:0 16px 40px #3714210d;border-radius:6px;font:400 1.5rem/1.55 var(--serif)}.letter[hidden]{display:none}.letter .sign{text-align:right;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:0}.wishes{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;text-align:left}.wishes li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:20px;min-height:100px}.wishes li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1;justify-content:center;text-align:center}.num{color:var(--gold);font:600 2.3rem var(--serif);flex:none}.photos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}.photo{margin:0;padding:10px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px}.photo-frame{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e7d4bd,#f5e9dc);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#795b60;overflow:hidden}.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.photo figcaption{font:italic 1.35rem var(--serif);padding:12px 4px 6px}.finale{text-align:center;padding:85px 24px;background:#371421;color:#fff4e4}.finale .eyebrow,.finale em{color:#e9c68b}.finale p{max-width:580px;margin:0 auto 26px}.finale .btn{background:#e9c68b;color:#371421}footer{text-align:center;padding:28px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}.particle{position:fixed;z-index:50;pointer-events:none;top:-25px;animation:fall var(--duration) linear forwards;color:var(--particle-color)}@keyframes fall{to{transform:translate(var(--drift),110vh) rotate(540deg);opacity:.15}}.reveal.ready{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s,transform .7s}.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}@media(max-width:650px){.navlinks{display:none}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.timeline,.photos,.wishes{grid-template-columns:1fr}.section{padding:60px 20px}.hero{padding:60px 28px}.hero:before{inset:10px}.hero:after{inset:16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.reveal.ready{opacity:1;transform:none}.particle{display:none}}
.photos{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.12fr 1fr;align-items:center}.photo-frame{aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--bg)}.photo-frame img{object-fit:contain;display:block}.photo:nth-child(2){border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 12px 30px #37142118}@media(max-width:650px){.photos{grid-template-columns:1fr}.photo-frame{aspect-ratio:auto}.photo-frame img{height:auto}}
</style></head>
<body>
<nav class="nav" aria-label="Main navigation"><a class="brand" href="#home">M &amp; D · 17</a><div class="navlinks"><a href="#journey">Our journey</a><a href="#memories">Memories</a><a href="#letter">Letter</a><a href="#wishes">17 wishes</a></div><button class="theme" id="theme" aria-label="Switch color theme" aria-pressed="false">☾</button><div class="progress" id="progress"></div></nav>
<header class="hero" id="home"><div id="stars" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="hero-inner"><svg class="rings" viewBox="0 0 110 70" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="#e9c68b" stroke-width="3"><circle cx="40" cy="37" r="25"/><circle cx="70" cy="37" r="25"/><path d="M33 10l7 -7 7 7-7 7z"/></g></svg><p class="eyebrow">25 November 2009 — 25 November 2026</p><div class="big17" aria-hidden="true">17</div><h1>Happy 17th Anniversary<em>Mom &amp; Dad</em></h1><div class="ornament" aria-hidden="true">♥</div><p>Seventeen years of love, laughter and teamwork. A little celebration for the two people who made our house a home.</p><a class="btn" href="#journey" id="begin">Begin your surprise ↓</a></div></header>
<main><section class="section reveal" id="journey"><p class="eyebrow">Every moment matters</p><h2>Time spent together</h2><p class="intro">Since the day you began this beautiful journey, every moment has become part of your story.</p><div class="stats" aria-label="Time since wedding date"><div class="stat"><b id="years">—</b><span>Years completed</span></div><div class="stat"><b id="days">—</b><span>Days together</span></div><div class="stat"><b id="hours">—</b><span>Hours</span></div><div class="stat"><b id="minutes">—</b><span>Minutes</span></div></div><p class="muted" id="dateNote" style="font-size:.8rem;margin-top:15px">Live counter, based on midnight on the wedding date.</p></section>
<div class="band"><section class="section reveal"><p class="eyebrow">A story still being written</p><h2>From then to forever</h2><div class="timeline"><article><strong>2009</strong><h3>The beginning</h3><p>November 25 — the day your journey as a married couple began.</p></article><article><strong>2026</strong><h3>17 wonderful years</h3><p>Celebrating all the little moments, lessons and memories along the way.</p></article><article><strong>∞</strong><h3>The next chapter</h3><p>More laughter, adventures, happiness and beautiful memories to come.</p></article></div></section></div>
<section class="section reveal" id="memories"><p class="eyebrow">Moments to treasure</p><h2>Our memory album</h2><p class="intro">Some moments deserve a special place.</p><div class="photos">
<figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mom and Dad together" loading="lazy"></div><figcaption>Together through the years</figcaption></figure>
<figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Our family of four" loading="lazy"></div><figcaption>Our family, our happiness</figcaption></figure>
<figure class="photo"><div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Mom and Dad at a celebration" loading="lazy"></div><figcaption>Still making memories</figcaption></figure></div></section>
<div class="band"><section class="section reveal" id="letter"><p class="eyebrow">Especially for you</p><h2>A letter from the heart</h2><p class="intro">A few words from both of us, for the two people who mean so much to us.</p><div class="envelope" id="envelope"><button class="seal" id="openLetter" aria-label="Open your anniversary letter" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="letterBody">♥</button><p>To Mom &amp; Dad · With love</p></div><div class="letter" id="letterBody" hidden><p>Dear Mom and Dad,</p><p>Happy 17th Anniversary! Today, we celebrate not only the seventeen years you have spent together, but also the beautiful family and countless memories you have created along the way.</p><p>Thank you for always being there for us, for believing in our dreams, and for doing so much to make us happy. From the smallest everyday moments to the biggest milestones, you have filled our lives with love, laughter and happiness.</p><p>We may not say it every day, but we are incredibly grateful for everything you do. You have taught us the importance of kindness, patience, hard work and standing by the people we love. We are proud to be your children.</p><p>As you begin another year together, we wish you endless happiness, good health, beautiful adventures and many more reasons to smile. May your bond grow stronger with every passing year.</p><p>Happy 17th Anniversary, Mom and Dad! We love you both more than words can express.</p><p class="sign">With all our love,<br>Pranav &amp; Karthik ♥</p></div></section></div>
<section class="section reveal" id="wishes"><p class="eyebrow">One for every year</p><h2>17 wishes for 17 years</h2><ol class="wishes" id="wishList"></ol></section>
<section class="finale"><p class="eyebrow">November 25, 2026</p><h2>Here’s to <em>forever.</em></h2><p>May the next chapter be filled with happiness, good health and countless beautiful memories. Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad!</p><button class="btn" id="celebrate">Celebrate together ✦</button><p id="celebrationMessage" role="status" style="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0"></p></section></main>
<footer>Made with love by Pranav &amp; Karthik, especially for Mom &amp; Dad. ♡</footer>
<script>
'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const wishes=['May every morning begin with a shared smile.','Thank you for showing us what teamwork really looks like.','Here’s to the laughs that still catch you both off guard.','For turning an ordinary house into a home.','For being each other’s calm in every storm.','For the quiet sacrifices you never made a big deal of.','May your evenings stay slow and your conversations long.','For the way you still finish each other’s sentences.','For teaching us that love is mostly small, daily choices.','May your hearts stay as young as the day you said “I do.”','For every festival, trip and family photo we’ll treasure.','For forgiving quickly and laughing sooner.','May good health walk beside you at every step.','For holding hands through the hard years and the happy ones.','For being the example we look up to.','May the next 17 years be even sweeter than these.','Happy anniversary, Mom and Dad. We love you both!'];
wishes.forEach((wish,i)=>{const li=document.createElement('li'),num=document.createElement('span'),msg=document.createElement('span');num.className='num';num.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');num.textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0');msg.textContent=wish;li.append(num,msg);$('wishList').append(li)});
function updateClock(){const now=new Date(),start=new Date(2009,10,25),elapsed=Math.max(0,now-start);let years=now.getFullYear()-2009;if(now.getMonth()<10||(now.getMonth()===10&&now.getDate()<25))years--;const days=(Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate())-Date.UTC(2009,10,25))/86400000;const values={years:Math.max(0,years),days:Math.max(0,days),hours:Math.floor(elapsed/3600000),minutes:Math.floor(elapsed/60000)};Object.entries(values).forEach(([key,value])=>$(key).textContent=value.toLocaleString('en-US'));}updateClock();setInterval(updateClock,1000);
for(let i=0;i<44;i++){const s=document.createElement('span');s.className='star';s.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';s.style.top=Math.random()*100+'%';s.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*4+'s';$('stars').append(s)}
function celebrate(count=55){if(reduced.matches)return;document.querySelectorAll('.particle').forEach(p=>p.remove());const symbols=['♥','✦','●','◆'],colors=['#d8b36b','#d45d83','#f7d8ce','#a82d50'];for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const p=document.createElement('span');p.className='particle';p.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');p.textContent=symbols[i%4];p.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';p.style.fontSize=8+Math.random()*15+'px';p.style.setProperty('--duration',3+Math.random()*3+'s');p.style.setProperty('--drift',Math.random()*160-80+'px');p.style.setProperty('--particle-color',colors[i%4]);p.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*.7+'s';document.body.append(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),7200)}}
$('begin').addEventListener('click',()=>celebrate(30));$('celebrate').addEventListener('click',()=>{celebrate(80);$('celebrationMessage').textContent='Happy 17th anniversary! ♥'});
$('openLetter').addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=$('letterBody').hidden;$('letterBody').hidden=!open;$('envelope').classList.toggle('open',open);$('openLetter').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));$('openLetter').setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close your anniversary letter':'Open your anniversary letter');if(open){celebrate(22);$('letterBody').scrollIntoView({behavior:reduced.matches?'instant':'smooth',block:'nearest'})}});
function setTheme(dark){document.documentElement.dataset.theme=dark?'dark':'light';$('theme').textContent=dark?'☀':'☾';$('theme').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(dark));}let saved;try{saved=localStorage.getItem('anniversary-theme')}catch(e){}setTheme(saved?saved==='dark':matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);$('theme').addEventListener('click',()=>{const dark=document.documentElement.dataset.theme!=='dark';setTheme(dark);try{localStorage.setItem('anniversary-theme',dark?'dark':'light')}catch(e){}});
if('IntersectionObserver' in window&&!reduced.matches){const io=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.08});document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>{el.classList.add('ready');io.observe(el)})}function progress(){const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;$('progress').style.width=(max>0?Math.min(100,Math.max(0,scrollY/max*100)):0)+'%'}addEventListener('scroll',progress,{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',progress);progress();
</script></body></html>
